official_definition: Up to twice per turn, you can send a total of three cards from your Hand and decktop to the Trash. When you've done so, this Spirit can refresh, and during this battle, you can increase the LV cost of an opposing Spirit/Nexus by +3.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Dark Assault] or [Dark Assault: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Dark Assault]", "give [Dark Assault]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Transitions state from EXHAUSTED to REFRESHED.
